name: St. Anthony's Free Clothing Program
description: Free clothing for adults, families, and children at SF's largest free clothing program; by appointment, no eligibility requirements
fullDescription: St. Anthony's runs San Francisco's largest free clothing program, offering new and gently used clothing in a boutique-style store. Anyone with a self-determined need is welcome; all visits are by appointment.
whatTheyOffer:
- Free clothing for adults and families
- Casual wear and warm clothes
- Business attire
- Children's clothing
- Individual Service (adults 18+) and Family Service (families with children under 18)
- No eligibility or income requirements
howToGetIt:
1. First-time guests (or those who haven't shopped in over a year) register in person with Guest Services, 1st floor of 121 Golden Gate Ave
2. Staff may ask for ID; Family Service asks for a document showing custody of children
3. Returning guests book an appointment every 28 days at FreeClothingSF.org (no email or phone booking)
4. Individual Service: Mon-Fri 8:15am-12pm
5. Family Service: Mon, Tue, Thu, Fri 1-4pm and Sat 8:30am-3pm
6. Shop on the 2nd floor at your appointment time
address: 121 Golden Gate Avenue, 2nd Floor, San Francisco, CA 94102
keywords: St. Anthony's, free clothing, San Francisco, men, women, children, shoes, Tenderloin, no income requirement
